constraints.definition: CHECK ((((result = 'STARTED'::text) AND (finished_at IS NULL)) OR (result = 'UNKNOWN'::text) OR ((result <> ALL (ARRAY['STARTED'::text, 'UNKNOWN'::text])) AND (finished_at IS NOT NULL))))

constraints.name: print_bindings_revocation_ck
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((state = 'REVOKED'::text) = ((revoked_at IS NOT NULL) AND (revoked_by_id IS NOT NULL))) AND ((revoked_at IS NULL) = (revoked_by_id IS NULL))))

constraints.definition: CHECK (((lease_epoch >= 0) AND ((lease_owner IS NULL) = (lease_until IS NULL))))

constraints.name: print_documents_initial_ck
constraints.definition: CHECK (((initial_state = ANY (ARRAY['OPEN'::text, 'INITIAL_REGISTERED'::text, 'HISTORICAL_CLOSED'::text])) AND (((initial_state = 'OPEN'::text) AND (closed_by_intent_id IS NULL)) OR ((initial_state <> 'OPEN'::text) AND (closed_by_intent_id IS NOT NULL)))))

constraints.name: print_documents_refs_ck
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((document_kind = 'SALE'::text) AND (sale_id IS NOT NULL) AND (synthetic_key IS NULL) AND (family = 'SALE_RECEIPT'::text)) OR ((document_kind = 'SYNTHETIC'::text) AND (sale_id IS NULL) AND (synthetic_key IS NOT NULL) AND (family = 'SYNTHETIC_TEST'::text))))

constraints.name: print_documents_synthetic_ck
constraints.definition: CHECK (((document_kind <> 'SYNTHETIC'::text) OR ((initial_state = 'OPEN'::text) AND (initial_intent_id IS NULL) AND (closed_by_intent_id IS NULL))))

constraints.definition: CHECK ((((actor_kind = 'USER'::text) AND (actor_user_id IS NOT NULL)) OR ((actor_kind = ANY (ARRAY['SYSTEM'::text, 'SYNTHETIC_EXECUTOR'::text])) AND (actor_user_id IS NULL))))

constraints.name: print_events_chain_ck
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((job_id IS NULL) OR (document_id IS NOT NULL)) AND ((copy_id IS NULL) OR (job_id IS NOT NULL)) AND ((attempt_id IS NULL) OR (copy_id IS NOT NULL)) AND ((destination_id IS NULL) OR (attempt_id IS NOT NULL))))

constraints.name: print_events_details_ck
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((details IS NULL) OR (jsonb_typeof(details) = 'object'::text)) AND ((details_purged_at IS NULL) OR (details IS NULL))))

constraints.name: print_events_proof_ck
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((proof_kind = 'NONE'::text) AND (evidence_hash IS NULL) AND (evidence_key IS NULL)) OR ((proof_kind = ANY (ARRAY['SYNTHETIC_NO_EFFECT'::text, 'SYNTHETIC_EGRESS_CLOSED'::text, 'SYNTHETIC_ATOMIC_QUEUE'::text, 'SYNTHETIC_TRANSPORT_ACCEPTED'::text, 'SYNTHETIC_SPOOLER_ACCEPTED'::text, 'SYNTHETIC_BROWSER_AVAILABLE'::text])) AND (attempt_id IS NOT NULL) AND (evidence_hash IS NOT NULL) AND (evidence_key IS NOT NULL) AND (actor_kind = 'SYNTHETIC_EXECUTOR'::text))))

constraints.definition: CHECK ((((scope_kind = 'DOCUMENT'::text) AND (document_id IS NOT NULL) AND (binding_version_id IS NULL) AND (delegation_id IS NULL)) OR ((scope_kind = 'BINDING'::text) AND (binding_version_id IS NOT NULL) AND (document_id IS NULL) AND (delegation_id IS NULL) AND (job_id IS NULL) AND (copy_id IS NULL) AND (attempt_id IS NULL) AND (destination_id IS NULL)) OR ((scope_kind = 'DELEGATION'::text) AND (delegation_id IS NOT NULL) AND (document_id IS NULL) AND (binding_version_id IS NULL) AND (job_id IS NULL) AND (copy_id IS NULL) AND (attempt_id IS NULL) AND (destination_id IS NULL))))

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.p004_delete_guard()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF TG_TABLE_NAME = 'print_requests' THEN
  IF OLD.expires_at < clock_timestamp() THEN RETURN OLD; END IF;
 END IF;
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'p004 ledger deletion requires separate approved retirement/retention scope';
END $function$
